text:
jamie: Kicking off RC creation for v2.14.0. Need canary plan and sheriff for promo window 03/25 18:00-19:00 PT. artifacts: infra-service@sha256:9a7f, model-bundle@sha256:c4e2.
sasha: QA smoke passed on staging, ran the 20-sample perf suite, 95th latency looks fine (~120ms). still seeing a tiny mem spike on long prompt test. attaching logs.
linh: infra readiness check: GPU pool has capacity for 2x canaries + variance slot. KV warm job queued. will warm at T-15.
miguel: Suggest a 5/50/45 traffic split over 30m with auto-fallback to model-bundle-quant if error rate >1.5%. canary health probes: 200s, latency, error-rate.
jamie: ok set split and fallback. @alex-oncall can you be sheriff for the window?
alex-oncall: I can. I'll watch telemetry and own rollback if anything weird. add me to incident pager. :thumbsup:
deploybot: [deploybot] RC artifact registered: rc-v2.14.0 (infra-service@9a7f, model-bundle@c4e2). Status: PENDING_KV_WARM. Run: `/deploy rc create rc-v2.14.0 --artifacts infra-service@9a7f,model-bundle@c4e2 --notes https://redwood.docs/release-notes/v2.14.0`
sasha: QA note: regression tests showed one flaky rerank case (flips occasionally). created ticket RWD-4123. not blocking canary but flagging for watch.
linh: KV warm logs:
```
WARM START rc-v2.14.0
warming shard gpu-3/slot-1 ... ok
prefetch keys 12/12
WARM COMPLETE
```
linh: KV warm complete at T-15.
miguel: Deploybot: please start canary deploy when ready. set traffic 5% -> 50% over 30m, health-check interval 60s.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary deploy started by jamie. Traffic schedule: 5% (0-5m) -> 50% (5-35m) -> evaluate. Health policy: rollback_on_error_rate=1.5%, latency_p95_increase=20%.
jamie: Noting release notes link: https://redwood.docs/release-notes/v2.14.0 (PR #3489). docs-bot, can you validate that release notes include rollback instructions and owner list?
docs-bot: [docs-bot] Release notes check: owners present (jamie, sasha, linh), rollback section OK, migration notes present. minor typo fixed in section 'model pinned variants'.
(12m later) sasha: Canary at 5% looks stable, latency unchanged, error-rate 0.2%. moving to 50% now.
(deploybot) deploybot: Traffic moved to 50%. monitoring window started.
(18m later) miguel: At 50% for ~13m. A single client reported increased 429s (burst). spike correlates with client x retry flood. mitigation: temporary rate-limit on client x. I don't think this needs rollback.
alex-oncall: Agreed, apply client-side rate-limit throttle (now). I'll keep eyes on SLOs for next 10m.
jamie: Proceeding with promo checklist: CHANGELOG updated, migration flag set to v2.14, DB change nil, ops runbook linked. deploying to prod after green at 50% for 30m total.
sasha: Confirming rerank flaky case not reproduced during canary. leaving RWD-4123 for post-promo investigation.
(30m after start) deploybot: Health gates passed. Final checks: p95 latency delta +3%, error-rate 0.35%. Ready to promote.
jamie: +1 from me. @alex-oncall final go/no-go?
alex-oncall: Go. No blockers, telemetry stable. I'll be on-call for first 2 hours post-promo.
miguel: tagging rollout policy: gradual 50% -> 100% over 20m with automatic fallback to model-bundle-quant if error-rate >1.5% or p95 delta >25%.
deploybot: Promotion started. Rolling to prod in stages.
(10m later) deploybot: Stage 1 -> 100% of region A. Stage 2 -> 100% global in progress.
jamie: Noticing a small uptick in latency for long-context queries (+8% p95) but within tolerance. continue.
sasha: Release notes live. Customer comms draft ready.
docs-bot: Release-notes publish confirmed.
alex-oncall: All clear so far. No rollback needed.
jamie: Promo complete. Tagging RC as promoted: rc-v2.14.0 -> prod. Closing thread; postmortem if RWD-4123 causes regressions. :party_popper:"
